keyDates.text: Early Decision / Early Action deadline for Brown, Harvard, Yale, Columbia, Cornell, Dartmouth, MIT, Stanford, Penn. SAT score sends must clear by Oct 25 to meet Nov 1 deadlines.
SAT November test date -- last opportunity for applicants who are unsatisfied with October scores to retest before most ED/EA decisions.
DHS public comment deadline on proposed $70,000 OPT fee rule (Federal Register Docket ICEB-2026-0100). Higher ed institutions urged to submit formal comments.
Expected Early Decision notification window opens for most Ivy League and peer institutions for Class of 2031 applicants.
Brown and Cornell Regular Decision application deadline (11:59 p.m. local time).
Harvard, Yale, Princeton, Columbia, Dartmouth, Penn Regular Decision deadline.
Ivy Day 2027 anticipated -- all eight Ivies expected to release Regular Decision results for Class of 2031 simultaneously.
National Candidates Reply Date -- admitted students must confirm enrollment. Key yield management deadline for all institutions.

charts.title: Ivy League 2027 US News National University Rankings
charts.sourceText: US News and World Report Best Colleges 2027 / Brown Daily Herald, September 22, 2026
charts.footnote: Lower rank number = better. MIT (non-Ivy) holds No. 1. Brown dropped from No. 13 to No. 16, lowest in the Ivy League.

charts.title: Select University Endowment Returns: FY2026
charts.sourceText: Forbes / Harvard Crimson / Brown University News, October 16, 2026
charts.footnote: Returns are net of investment expenses for the 12-month period ending June 30, 2026. Brown figure from Brown University press release dated Oct. 9, 2026.

charts.title: Brown Class of 2025: Sector Employment vs. Ivy Peers
charts.sourceText: Brown Daily Herald (Hansen '30 opinion, citing university employment data), October 19, 2026
charts.footnote: Figures represent percentage of Class of 2025 employed in nonprofit or government sectors. Lower employment share in these sectors correlates with higher US News Earnings by Major scores.
